text:
maya: FYI scheduling a short maintenance for control-plane rack `rack-cp-9` next Wed 02:30 UTC (90m window). Purpose: apply kernel livepatch + reboot controller nodes in cohorts. Expected impact: brief control-plane API latency spikes and transient leader elections. No GPU compute drains planned.

maya: High level plan: cordon -> drain non-critical control-plane pods -> soft-reboot -> kv preseed -> verify. Cohorts of 2 nodes across 6-node rack. Stagger 12m between cohorts to preserve etcd quorum.

jamie: +1 on cohorts. Recommend running `kvcache-check` and `route-shadow` after each cohort to detect routing flaps early. Can we add a synthetic write perf after cohort2?

maya: plan includes `kvcache-seed` and `route-shadow`. Synthetic write after cohort2 for 15m. Abort criteria: API 95th > 700ms or >2 leader elections in 10m.

liam: I'll own canary/synthetic and be on-call. I'll post results 20m before start. Also preparing quick rollback: `infra-rollback-controlplane --rack rack-cp-9 --force` and `route-evict-shadow`.

ops-bot: Reminder created ticket #INC-3309. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/ops/runbooks/controlplane-maintenance. Pager: eng-infra-oncall.

kevin: Support: status page notice draft queued. We'll email customers in EU/US operations groups 6h before. Create PSAT for common questions about Dedicated pools.

sasha: Product: confirm no Dedicated capacity migrations or model rollouts overlap. Also flag any enterprise tenants with pinned control-plane routing.

maya: Confirmed: no Dedicated migrations. We'll set `dedicated-safe` flag in the ticket.

tony: Ops note: cross-region fallback may route extra control-plane RPCs to us-east. Bandwidth estimate small but call out in comms. Might affect control-plane billing slightly.

nora: Security: ensure KMS endpoints are reachable during maintenance; will run a quick pre-check tomorrow.

liam: Canary preflight scheduled at 02:10 UTC to run synthetic control-plane ops for 20m. If p95 < 350ms proceed. If p95 between 350-700ms proceed with caution and extra 15m observation. If p95 > 700ms abort.

maya: Thanks. Ops run commands for runbook snippet:
```
infra-cordon --rack rack-cp-9 --nodes 2
infra-drain --grace 120
infra-reboot --type soft
kvcache-seed --after 300
infra-verify-controlplane --checks ethd,api,pods
```

ton y: ACK (oncall).

liam: ACK (sre). I'll be present.

kevin: ACK (support). Status page and PSAT set.

sasha: ACK (product). Added note to upcoming customer comms doc.

maya: Posting final ticket and runbook link. Reach out on this thread if anything changes. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Ticket #INC-3309 state -> scheduled. Notifying eng-infra-oncall.

maya: Will post a post-op summary + template within 24h after maintenance completes.
